description: Evaluation suite for evaluating-ml-models skill covering cross-validation, metrics, hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, and model comparison

task_evals.name: Cross-Validation Strategy Selection
task_evals.description: Choose appropriate CV strategy for time series data
task_evals.prompt: I'm working with a time series dataset to predict stock prices. What cross-validation strategy should I use and why is regular K-fold not appropriate?
expected_behavior: Explains why K-fold causes data leakage for time series
negative_indicators: Recommends standard K-fold for time series

task_evals.name: Metrics for Imbalanced Classification
task_evals.description: Select appropriate metrics for imbalanced classification
task_evals.prompt: My fraud detection dataset has 99% legitimate transactions and 1% fraud. What metrics should I use to evaluate my model, and why is accuracy misleading here?
expected_behavior: Explains why accuracy is misleading for imbalanced data
Recommends precision, recall, F1, or PR-AUC
Mentions ROC-AUC limitations for severe imbalance
negative_indicators: Only mentions accuracy and nothing else

task_evals.name: Hyperparameter Tuning with Optuna
task_evals.description: Set up Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter tuning
task_evals.prompt: How do I use Optuna to tune hyperparameters for my Random Forest classifier? I want to optimize n_estimators and max_depth.
negative_indicators: Uses grid search instead of Optuna

task_evals.name: Experiment Tracking Setup
task_evals.description: Set up MLflow for experiment tracking
task_evals.prompt: How do I track my model training experiments with MLflow? I want to log hyperparameters, metrics, and save the model.

task_evals.name: Regression Metrics Selection
task_evals.description: Choose appropriate metrics for regression problems
task_evals.prompt: I'm evaluating a house price prediction model. What metrics should I use, and what's the difference between MAE and RMSE?
expected_behavior: Recommends MAE, RMSE, and R² for regression
Explains RMSE penalizes large errors more
Mentions MAE is more robust to outliers
